Eyes hugely hopeful with red irises looking DOWN to phone, raised inner brows, CLOSED strained upturned smile with one worried corner. She waits for approval, not excited gamer.

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop

One huge eye and other narrowed, ridges unequal, OPEN sideways three-upper-tooth rant. Outrage at something trivial, not soldier with angryVgrin; no floating flames.
